name: ClickSyncr for Brevo – Contact Form 7, WPForms, Gravity Forms, Ninja Forms, Fluent Forms, Formidable & Forminator
author: ClickSyncr

sections.description:
ClickSyncr for Brevo – Contact Form 7, WPForms, Gravity Forms, Ninja Forms, Fluent Forms, Formidable & Forminator connects your forms to Brevo (formerly Sendinblue), so every form submission becomes a contact in your Brevo list: automatically, with no code.

Works with your form builder

  • Contact Form 7
  • WPForms
  • Gravity Forms
  • Ninja Forms
  • Fluent Forms
  • Formidable Forms
  • Forminator

One plugin, one Brevo connection. ClickSyncr configures each form right inside the builder you already use, and it connects your forms to 20+ other email marketing platforms too.

“Brevo” and “Sendinblue” are trademarks of Sendinblue SAS. This plugin is an independent integration and is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by Sendinblue SAS or Brevo.

Why you’ll love it

  • Set up in minutes: paste your Brevo v3 API key and you’re connected. No developers, no code.
  • Your lists load automatically: choose which Brevo list new contacts join, right inside the form editor.
  • Map any attribute: send names, phone numbers, and your custom Brevo attributes straight from your form.
  • Typed attributes done right: boolean and number attributes arrive as real booleans and numbers, so Brevo never silently drops them.
  • Resilient phone sync: an invalid phone number never costs you the lead; the rest of the contact still syncs.
  • Built-in opt-in: add a consent checkbox and ClickSyncr adds the contact when a visitor ticks it, and sends nothing at all when they leave it unticked.
  • Subscriber status control: add directly or send Brevo’s confirmation email, per form.
  • No duplicate contacts: Brevo matches contacts by email, so existing contacts are updated and new ones are created, every single time.
  • A setup for every form: each form can sync to a different Brevo list with its own attribute mapping, in every supported builder.
  • Sync health at a glance: an admin-bar menu shows every form’s Brevo sync counts and the last error, if any.
  • Lightweight and fast: built to WordPress standards, so it never slows your site down.
  • You stay in control: you decide exactly what data is sent to Brevo, and to which list.

Learn more about the forms to Brevo integration.

What you’ll need

  • WordPress 6.7 or higher
  • At least one supported form builder: Contact Form 7, WPForms, Gravity Forms, Ninja Forms, Fluent Forms, Formidable Forms, or Forminator
  • A Brevo account with a v3 API key (free accounts work)

Getting your Brevo API key

  1. Log in to your Brevo account.
  2. Go to Settings > SMTP & API > API Keys.
  3. Generate a new v3 API key.
  4. Paste it into the ClickSyncr for Brevo – Contact Form 7, WPForms, Gravity Forms, Ninja Forms, Fluent Forms, Formidable & Forminator settings of any form.

Support

Need a hand? Browse the documentation, check the frequently asked questions, or contact us and we’ll be glad to help.

Brevo

Connected forms send their submissions to Brevo. Read more at Brevo.

External services

Diagnostic sharing is on by default and can be turned off in the Advanced section of any connected form. It sends software versions, aggregate configuration and delivery counts, and random installation/device identifiers to Signls. It excludes contact/submission values and credentials. See privacy details.

This plugin connects to Brevo. When you connect, refresh or open a configured form’s settings, it authenticates with your API key and requests the available lists, fields and account settings. A configured form submission sends the email address and the fields you map to your selected destination. A test submission sends the test address and configured fields. Subscription and consent settings determine whether a submission is sent.

Terms of service | Privacy policy

Privacy

ClickSyncr does not set tracking cookies or send visitor IP addresses to a geolocation service. If you map context fields, the mapped page URL, IP address, browser information or submission time is sent to Brevo. Optional sender context adds the page, form, time and browser to the site owner’s notification email. API credentials, form settings and sync counters are stored in your WordPress database. Administrators can enable a local diagnostic log with redacted personal data. ClickSyncr does not receive your form submissions.
sections.installation:
Automatic installation

  1. Log in to your WordPress dashboard.
  2. Go to Plugins > Add New.
  3. Search for “ClickSyncr for Brevo – Contact Form 7, WPForms, Gravity Forms, Ninja Forms, Fluent Forms, Formidable & Forminator”.
  4. Click Install Now, then Activate.

Manual installation

  1. Download the plugin ZIP file.
  2. In your WordPress dashboard, go to Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin.
  3. Choose the ZIP file and click Install Now.
  4. Activate the plugin.

After installation

  1. Edit any form and open its ClickSyncr for Brevo – Contact Form 7, WPForms, Gravity Forms, Ninja Forms, Fluent Forms, Formidable & Forminator settings.
  2. Paste your Brevo v3 API key, choose a list, and map your fields (email is required).
  3. Save. Every submission now syncs to Brevo automatically. Full guidance lives on the ClickSyncr for Brevo – Contact Form 7, WPForms, Gravity Forms, Ninja Forms, Fluent Forms, Formidable & Forminator page.
sections.faq:
Do I need a Brevo account?

Yes. You’ll need an active Brevo account and a v3 API key to sync your contacts. Free Brevo accounts work.

Which form builders are supported?

Contact Form 7, WPForms, Gravity Forms, Ninja Forms, Fluent Forms, Formidable Forms, and Forminator. At least one of them must be installed and activated.

Does this work with Sendinblue?

Yes. Brevo is the new name for Sendinblue, and this plugin works with the same accounts and the same v3 API keys.

Where do I find my Brevo API key?

Log in to Brevo and go to Settings > SMTP & API > API Keys, then generate a new v3 API key. Each builder setup guide shows exactly where to paste it.

Which fields can I map?

Map your form fields to any of your account’s contact attributes: first name, last name, phone numbers, and every custom attribute you have created in Brevo. Boolean and number attributes are sent with the correct types.

How does the opt-in consent field work?

Pick a consent field (a checkbox, acceptance, or radio) from your form. When a visitor ticks it, the contact is sent to Brevo; if they leave it unticked, nothing is sent at all, so nobody is added without agreeing. Leave it as “None” to use the subscriber status you chose for the form.

Does it work with Brevo double opt-in?

Yes. Choose the confirmation-email status and ClickSyncr uses Brevo’s double opt-in flow with an active email template tagged “optin” from your account. Contacts join the list after they click the confirmation link.

Will it create duplicate contacts?

No. Brevo matches contacts by email address: existing contacts are updated and new ones are created.

Can I use different settings for different forms?

Yes. Every form has its own ClickSyncr for Brevo – Contact Form 7, WPForms, Gravity Forms, Ninja Forms, Fluent Forms, Formidable & Forminator setup, so each can sync to a different list.

ClickSyncr for Brevo – Contact Form 7, WPForms, Gravity Forms, Ninja Forms, Fluent Forms, Formidable & Forminator Privacy

The plugin sends only the fields you map, and only to Brevo. Nothing is collected by ClickSyncr itself. Read about our policy.
